tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /mthu ldan tsa turmu kha'i bstod bskul dgra sde 'joms pa'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba bzhugs// rgyal ba bud+dha dh+wa dza'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ drag gtum mi zad rab tu khros pa'i sku/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhis nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'dul/ /srid gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i mthu bo che/ /stobs ldan zhing skyong dbang po khyod la bstod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /rnam 'phrul du mas dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /dam tshig ldan pa bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing che la bstod/ /gtum chen zhal bzhis khams gsum gdug pa gsol/ /rab rgyas phyag bzhi sna tshogs mtshon cha brel/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i steng na bro rdung ba'i/ /rtsal chen gnyan gyi mgon po khyod la bstod/ /ti se bsil ba'i tshal dang po ta la/ /ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod la sogs par/ /brtan par bzhugs nas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje nag po chen por kun nas bstod/ /mthu stobs shugs 'chang khyod kyi phyogs bzhi na/ /dgra bgegs srog la rngam pa'i khro mo bzhi/ /nag ser dmar dang ljang ba'i sku mdog can/ /gri gug thod 'dzin sring mo bzhi la bstod/ /rtsal drag mnga' bdag yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /mnyes byed dam rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis/ /sa dang bar snang khyab pa 'di bzhes la/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sngon tshe grub chen ri sul rnal 'byor mas/ /gnyan lo chen po'i bran du khyod gtad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /dam nyams bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel gdong bzhi mthu bo che/ /las la bzhengs la rtags mtshan myur du phyungs/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe ring nad med 'dod don kun 'grub ste/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rab rgyas nas/

/'jig rten bde zhing skyid pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gis reg pa la brten nas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che srog ltar gces par 'dzin pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ bsam rtse brang mo cher dad 'dus kyi skye bo 'ga' zhig la chos skyong 'di'i rjes gnang byas dus myur ba nyid du sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mthu ldan tsaturmukha'i bstod bskul dgra sde 'joms pa'i mtshon cha/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
